claims.sentence: The first aim of this project is to longitudinally monitor psychological functioning and sleep- and eating-related behaviours in a large sample of students aged 14-17 yrs. (N = 854), to identify the variables that predict transition from a prodromal phase to a clinical stage, and signpost individuals at risk or with clinical symptoms to self-help materials and clinical support.
